# ferriskey_organization_group (Resource)

Manages a group inside an organization. Groups form a tree through `parent_group_id`. Group names must be unique within an organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ferriskey_organization_group" "engineering" {
  realm           = "acme"
  organization_id = ferriskey_organization.tenant.organization_uuid
  name            = "engineering"
  description     = "Engineering department"
}

resource "ferriskey_organization_group" "platform" {
  realm           = "acme"
  organization_id = ferriskey_organization.tenant.organization_uuid
  name            = "platform"
  parent_group_id = ferriskey_organization_group.engineering.group_uuid
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the group.
- `organization_id` (String) UUID of the organization. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `realm` (String) Realm the organization belongs to. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the group. Do not set an empty string: FerrisKey stores an empty description as unset.
- `parent_group_id` (String) UUID of the parent group; omit for a top-level group. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `group_uuid` (String) UUID of the group, assigned by FerrisKey.
- `id` (String) Composite identifier `{realm}/{organization_id}/{group_uuid}`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import ferriskey_organization_group.engineering acme/ORG_UUID/GROUP_UUID
```
